en.headline: City Hall hosts Charles Ng saxophone recital on Thursday
en.dek: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department lists an 8pm recital at Hong Kong City Hall Theatre on 8 October, with tickets at HK$220.
body: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department will present a saxophone recital by Charles Ng on Thursday as part of its Hong Kong Artists series.

The department's programme page lists the recital at 8pm on 8 October at the Theatre of Hong Kong City Hall. Tickets are priced at HK$220. The performance is scheduled to run about an hour and a half, including a 15-minute interval. An earlier department announcement said pianist Annie Yuen would join Ng.

The listed programme includes Chen Gang's Sunshine Over Tashkurgan and Paule Maurice's Tableaux de Provence, plus two Asia premieres: Gerald Preinfalk's Little Bitter Sweet Symphony and Miguel Farías's Cuaderno de la Pampa. A work written with local composer Charles Kwong, Celestial Architecture, is billed as a world premiere. The department said the presenter may change the programme or substitute artists.

zh.headline: 吳漢紳星期四於大會堂舉行色士風演奏會
zh.dek: 康文署「香港藝術家」系列列出，10月8日晚上8時在香港大會堂劇院演出，門票220元，節目約一小時三十分鐘。
body: 康樂及文化事務署將於星期四呈獻色士風演奏家吳漢紳的演奏會，屬「香港藝術家」系列。
署方節目頁列出，演出於10月8日晚上8時在香港大會堂劇院舉行，門票售價220元，全長約一小時三十分鐘，包括十五分鐘中場休息。署方較早前的英文公布表示，本地鋼琴家Annie Yuen會同台演出。
曲目包括陳鋼《陽光照耀在塔什庫爾干》及莫利斯《普羅旺斯風情畫》，另有兩首亞洲首演：普賴因法克《糖衣苦果小交響曲》及法里亞斯《潘帕草原手記》。與本地作曲家鄺展維合作的《天穹構築》列為世界首演。署方表示，主辦機構可更改節目或更換演出者。
